answer: By the opal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, re-queued for a second panel, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Work waits on the lantern until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the pearl of the next round. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
